KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_HOODED_MERCHANT.title: The Hooded Merchant
KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_HOODED_MERCHANT.pages.I: A hooded figure sits behind a crooked table, three offerings laid out before him. He says nothing. He only grins.
KAPPASTWEAKS-THE_HOODED_MERCHANT.pages.E: The card hums in your hand. The merchant nods, as if you passed a test you didn't know you were taking.
The merchant grins wider. [red]"IT EATS,"[/red] he says. [red]"AND THEN IT EATS AGAIN."[/red]
